content.short: We are a community takeover with dope art from a failed founder.
content.description:
We are a community that has taken over from a failed founder. He slow rugged us over a several month period. In several short weeks we have stabilized and tripled our NFT floors, made numerous collaborations, and have secured staking for our holders through Cardano Lands. Our project is community ran, and therefore the community decides the direction our project takes. Any decision of significant importance is voted on by the community. We still have nearly an entire 3D collection to release.

Our Discord and Twitter presence is top notch, with many community games and engagements to keep everyone excited for the project. We have 1007 holders of our original collection and have earned the respect of many partnered NFT projects. Our future goal is to continue to provide utility for the collection as well as bring utility and advantages to holding the Riot Pass. There are many other ideas as well that can help us stand out from other projects that will be part of the updated roadmap.

The community is encouraged as well to provide input and vote on the direction we take. Leaders here are just voices for the community.
